name: land-no-pthread-single-profile
title: Land no-pthread single-profile runtime
description: Convert this fork to one browser-first no-pthread runtime profile. Remove SharedArrayBuffer/cross-origin-isolation requirements, adapt the native build and wrapper/release contracts, validate locally first, and trigger expensive remote native builds only after static and unit gates pass.
creator: killbus
notes: Qualified and published the single-profile no-pthread runtime from clean build 33412490741; removed pthread workers and cross-origin-isolation requirements; removed heavyweight runtime payloads from Git LFS; and moved CI, release, Pages, font, local build, and package flows to deterministic restoration from the pinned qualified public Release. Local runtime, browser, conversion, package, clean-tree, and focused contract gates passed, followed by PR CI.
